scenes.description: A dimly lit, cramped prison cell. The camera pans across the stone walls, focusing on a small, flickering candle on a wooden table. The prisoner, a young woman with determined eyes, looks up as the candle sputters out.
scenes.camera_angle: Low angle, slowly pulling back to reveal the entire cell.
scenes.lighting: Low-key lighting with a single candle providing a warm, amber glow. Shadows dominate the corners of the cell.
scenes.sound_effects: Soft, distant clanking of metal doors, a faint wind whistling through a crack in the wall.

scenes.description: The prisoner discovers a hidden compartment behind a loose brick. She pulls out a rusted key and a crumpled map of the prison layout.
scenes.camera_angle: Close-up on the hand as it slides the brick aside, then a top-down view of the map.
scenes.lighting: A sudden burst of light from a hidden shaft illuminates the compartment, casting dramatic highlights on the key and map.
scenes.sound_effects: A soft metallic click as the brick moves, followed by a faint rustle of paper.

scenes.description: Nighttime. The prisoner silently navigates the dark corridors, using the map to avoid guards. Shadows dance on the walls as torches flicker.
scenes.camera_angle: Tracking shot following the prisoner from behind, intercut with over-the-shoulder shots of the map.
scenes.lighting: Cool, blue-toned moonlight filtering through narrow windows, contrasted with the warm orange of torches.
scenes.sound_effects: Echoing footsteps, distant murmurs of guards, the occasional creak of old wood.

scenes.description: The prisoner reaches the outer wall. She uses the key to unlock a hidden gate, revealing a moonlit courtyard beyond.
scenes.camera_angle: Wide shot of the wall, then a close-up on the key turning in the lock.
scenes.lighting: Silvery moonlight bathing the courtyard, creating a stark contrast with the darkness of the interior.
scenes.sound_effects: The metallic clank of the lock, a soft sigh of wind as the gate opens.

scenes.description: The final escape. The prisoner sprints across the courtyard, leaping over a low wall and disappearing into the night forest.
scenes.camera_angle: Slow-motion close-up of her face, then a wide aerial shot as she runs into the trees.
scenes.lighting: Moonlight filtering through the trees, creating dappled patterns on the ground.
scenes.sound_effects: Rapid heartbeat, rustling leaves, distant howls of night creatures.
